actions_taken: Diagnosed root cause: AMZN annual meeting 8-Ks from 2010-2015 use prose-style proposal descriptions with no numbered headers ('The appointment of Ernst & Young LLP...', 'A shareholder proposal...', 'An advisory vote...'), which are invisible to reProposalSplitter. Found 6 AMZN filings in the secwatch store (seq 47552, 47584, 48067, 48089, 48117, 48127) that correctly produce director rows but 0 proposals. Added reProseSplitter regex to parser.go with 5 prose-format patterns covering AMZN's observed proposal structures. Modified extractProposals() to call a new extractProseProposals() fallback when the primary numbered-format splitter returns 0 results — this ensures the prose fallback NEVER fires for numbered-format filings (SCHW/ABBV/BA/BLK/LLY) that also contain these phrases, preventing spurious sub-splits. Refactored extractAuditor() into auditorFromSplits() helper and added the same fallback so auditor name is correctly extracted from AMZN filings. Added 3 new tests: AMZNProseFormat (2010), AMZNProseFormat2011, NumberedFormatUnaffectedByProseFallback. All 3 new tests pass; full go test ./... suite passes.
notes: config/entity-graph-rules.json was not changed — the gap is purely a parser format issue, not a threshold issue. The observation was updated a second time (03:15:50Z, 4 filings 64 directors) while this run was in progress; the same prose-fallback fix applies to that batch. A spurious 'nomination_rejection' signal for entity 'Equity Disclosure' appeared in the 03:15 observation — this is a false-positive director-name extraction that may warrant a follow-up review of looksLikePersonName() for table-header phrases that escaped the current filter.
